notes.title: Hotfix #2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43693867/56ac854d4635c558677d44fc5897e99addb66855.png[/img]

Hello!
All fixes and new implementations come from you, the player, who pointed out to us the places where we can improve our game - [b]thank you![/b]

Changes:

- Fixed an issue with the Material of the 3 highest guitars strings, both in Main Menu and in-game; so, now they are not braided anymore.
- Fixed a collider of the new staircase.
- Fixed a bug which didn't allow to control audio volumes of doors and instruments.
- Fixed a bug which kept open the Augmented Reality panels in the Warehouse.
- Fixed several issues in the languages localizations.
- Removed the need to mouse hover twice the last point during the strings assembling. Now the activity is completed just after the first hover on the last point.
- Reworked the player's skills levels in the Prologue in order to allow to reach the 3-stars Achievement.
- Disabled the Normal Delivery in the Market app in the Prologue, in order to avoid confusion for players waiting for wares which won't arrive before the end of the Prologue.
- Added new keys binding to allow players to play the Instruments with 0-9 keyboard keys as well (useful for players which don't have the Numpad).
- Added the ESC key binding to close the Tablet.
- Added a new volume slider in the Audio Settings, specific for footsteps sounds.
- Added an auto-rotation mechanic when a gluing activity is started and the Instrument is upside down.
- Added a new player's Skill related to the use of hex keys (like setting the Trussrod), in order to allow the player to speed up the activity by buying the related courses.
- Added the camera movement while assembling frets and frets markers. Like during the painting and gluing processes, now the player can move the camera with "Q" and "E" keys.

We are constantly updating the game to bring you the best possible enjoyment, so if you want to share your opinion or point out a non-working element - welcome to the forum.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43693867/650e900f6b55b586ba1d5127e349c0593128b39a.png[/img]
